items.title: Staff+ Research Engineer, RL Data Platform
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic's RL Data Platform team builds the systems that produce, move, and serve the human data Claude learns from: the interfaces humans use to give feedback, the pipelines that turn raw feedback into training signal, and the tooling researchers use to launch, monitor, and inspect data collection. Every RL run depends on a steady supply of high-quality data - human feedback, expert demonstrations, graded transcripts - and when a researcher has an idea for new data on Monday, our job is to make it collectable by Wednesday and in the training mix by Friday. This is a full-stack, ownership-heavy role on a small, senior team. You'll design and ship web interfaces used by thousands of expert annotators, build the backend services and data pipelines behind them, and work directly with RL researchers to understand what data they need and why. You'll scope your own projects, make architectural calls, and see them through to production. We're looking for engineers who treat researchers as their users, build for reliability first, and care as much about the shape of the data leaving the system as the UI going into it. Key responsibilities Design, build, and operate the feedback and data collection interfaces used by human annotators, domain experts, and internal researchers. Build and maintain the backend services, APIs, and pipelines that route model samples to humans and return structured feedback to training. Own the reliability, latency, and usability of systems that run continuously against live model endpoints. Partner with RL researchers to translate loosely specified data needs into well-scoped collection campaigns and the tooling to run them. Build dashboards, monitoring, and inspection tools so researchers can see data quality and throughput without asking an engineer. Identify and remove the bottlenecks between "we want this data" and "it's in the training mix". Minimum qualifications Strong full-stack engineering skills, with production experience in TypeScript/React on the frontend and Python on the backend. Experience designing and operating backend services and data pipelines that other teams depend on. A track record of owning projects end-to-end, from an ambiguous brief to something in production that people use. Comfort working directly with technical stakeholders whose needs change week to week, and the judgment to push back when something isn't worth building. Effective use of AI tools in your own day-to-day work. Care about the societal impacts of your work. Preferred qualifications Experience building annotation, labelling, evaluation, or other human-in-the-loop data tooling. Experience with RLHF, preference data, or other human-feedback pipelines for ML systems. Experience shipping researcher-facing or other expert-facing internal tools people love: interviewing users, hunting down friction, measurably improving the experience. Experience running experiments on data collection interfaces and using the results to improve data quality. Experience working with crowdworker or expert vendor platforms at scale. Familiarity with how LLMs are trained and evaluated. Representative projects Build an interface that lets a domain expert review a long agentic transcript, flag the step where things went wrong, and write a corrected continuation - with the result landing in a training-ready format. Rework the sampling path between our feedback interfaces and model endpoints to cut time-to-first-sample for annotators. Build a campaign launcher that lets a researcher stand up a new data collection effort (task, rubric, population, quality checks) without writing code. Instrument annotator behaviour to detect low-effort or adversarial work and surface it to the quality team automatically. Design the data model for a kind of feedback we haven't collected before, and ship the pipeline that gets it into the training mix. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $500,000 — $850,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. items.title: Staff AI Deployment Strategist - UK & Nordics
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE As Staff AI Deployment Strategist, you will shape how some of the most ambitious enterprises in the UK & Nordics region adopt frontier AI at scale. This is a senior, high-impact role at the intersection of strategy, technology, and execution. You will work directly on Mistral’s most strategic opportunities and largest deliveries, helping customers move from ambition to measurable business outcomes. You will frame complex AI transformation programs, turn executive priorities into actionable roadmaps, and ensure that Mistral delivers systems that are valuable, scalable, and trusted. You will also act as a senior sponsor on our most critical customer programs, bringing judgment, structure, and delivery excellence to high-stakes engagements. Your mandate is to raise the ambition and quality of AI adoption: helping customers identify where AI can create step-change value, making the right trade-offs, and ensuring that execution matches the strategic promise. This role is ideal for an experienced strategy consultant, transformation leader, or senior operator who wants to move from advising on change to building it directly with frontier AI technology. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Shape high-impact AI transformations - Partner closely with Mistral’s Sales leadership in the UK & Nordics to qualify opportunities, align on account strategy, and drive executive engagement. - Work with senior customer stakeholders to identify where frontier AI can create material business value. - Structure complex opportunities into clear, credible, and executable transformation programs. - Translate strategic ambition into delivery roadmaps, success metrics, and operating plans. - Help customers make the right trade-offs between ambition, feasibility, speed, and long-term scalability. - Sponsor Mistral’s most strategic deliveries - Act as a senior sponsor on the largest and most complex customer programs, primarily in the UK & Nordics and potentially cross-region as priorities evolve. - Ensure delivery quality, executive alignment, and measurable business impact. - Anticipate risks, unblock decisions, and help teams navigate ambiguity in high-stakes environments. - Bring senior judgment to moments where scope, resources, timelines, or expected value need to be clarified. - Build repeatable deployment excellence - Turn lessons from strategic engagements into reusable approaches, playbooks, and patterns. - Raise the bar for how AI programs are qualified, framed, delivered, and scaled. - Act as a senior relay for the Solutions organization in the region, helping teams adopt shared best practices, adapt them thoughtfully to local market specificities when needed, and strengthen the quality of execution. - Work hand in hand with Solutions leadership to connect customer realities, delivery patterns, and field feedback into practical ways of improving how Mistral deploys AI. - Help codify what great enterprise AI deployment looks like across industries and use cases. - Contribute to a Solutions culture that combines strategic clarity, technical depth, and strong execution. - Develop and multiply senior DS impact - Coach Deployment Strategists on strategic problem-solving, executive communication, and delivery leadership. - Help teams raise the quality of their work on the highest-impact opportunities. - Identify capability gaps and contribute to hiring, staffing, and development priorities. - Act as a force multiplier across accounts, teams, and regions where your experience can have the highest leverage. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR You are a senior, highly capable professional with strong executive presence, excellent business judgment, and a track record of leading complex strategic or transformation work. Typical indicators we’re looking for include: - 8–10+ years of professional experience in strategy consulting, digital transformation, AI, enterprise technology, or a similarly demanding environment. - Experience operating at Partner, Principal, Engagement Manager, Director, or equivalent level in a top-tier strategy consulting or transformation context. - A strong ability to structure ambiguous problems, identify value, and turn strategy into execution. - Experience leading large accounts, complex programs, or senior customer relationships. - The credibility to engage with executives and C-level stakeholders on business priorities, trade-offs, and impact. - Strong analytical and commercial judgment, with the ability to challenge assumptions constructively. - Comfort working at the frontier of technology, even when solutions are evolving quickly and the path is not fully defined. - A low-ego, high-ownership mindset and a desire to build with customers and teams, not just advise from a distance. - Fluency in English; German is a strong plus. Hiring Process • Talent Acquisition screening call • 30min Hiring Manager Interview • 45min Business Acumen Interview • 60min Technical Deep Dive on LLMs • Panel (Home Prep & Restitution) • 30min Value Talk • Reference check WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.description: We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our Data Center of Excellence ( CoE ) team at Betsson Group. You'll design, build, and deploy AI and agentic solutions with real business impact, from LLM-driven pipelines to intelligent automation, while helping shape our technical direction. If you're passionate about applied AI and enjoy turning emerging research into production-grade systems, we'd love to hear from you! The Wow You'll be at the forefront of AI innovation in iGaming - a space where cutting-edge technology meets real-time, high-stakes decision-making. As part of our Data CoE , you'll take ownership of complex AI initiatives end-to-end, from architecture to deployment, working closely with stakeholders to translate business needs into production-grade solutions. You'll have the autonomy to solve hard problems independently, the platform to influence how AI is adopted across the business, and the opportunity to share your expertise with the wider team. A taster of what you will be involved with: Expect to independently design, build, and deploy LLM-powered pipelines and autonomous agents that solve real operational challenges from intelligent automation to advanced retrieval systems. You'll work closely with stakeholders to scope and deliver solutions, get hands-on with frameworks like LangChain , and help set best practices around MLOps and production-grade AI. You'll also have opportunities to mentor developers and contribute to internal knowledge-sharing as part of a well-rounded senior role. Then again, what else would you expect from a business 75% millennial and 1700 strong, spread across 7 offices with 900 based out of our Malta HQ alone! items.title: Corporate Counsel, M&A
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role We are seeking an experienced Corporate Counsel, M&A to join our corporate legal team. As Anthropic continues to scale, we need an M&A attorney who can drive strategic transactions, including acquisitions, acquihires, minority investments, joint ventures, and other structured deals, from initial diligence through execution and post-closing integration, and help us build the playbooks and processes to do it repeatably. You will work closely with our Legal, Corporate Development, Finance, Accounting, and executive teams to execute transactions that support Anthropic's mission and growth objectives. Key responsibilities Lead legal workstreams on M&A transactions — acquisitions, acquihires, minority investments, joint ventures, and other strategic transactions — from due diligence through closing and post-closing integration Draft, review, and negotiate transaction documents including letters of intent, purchase agreements, ancillary agreements, and related closing documentation Manage and coordinate due diligence, including oversight of cross-functional workstreams and third-party advisors Provide practical counsel on deal structuring, risk allocation, purchase price mechanics, indemnification, and other key transaction terms Prepare materials for executive leadership (and, as needed, the Board) on transaction matters Manage outside counsel relationships on transactions, including staffing, budgets, and work-product quality Represent Legal on post-closing integration, working cross-functionally to ensure smooth transitions Develop and maintain standardized processes, playbooks, and template documents that drive efficiency and best practices across M&A transactions Support other corporate matters as needed Minimum qualifications Hold a law degree (JD, LLB, or equivalent) and meet the local licensing requirements to work as in-house counsel where you'll be based Experience drafting and negotiating M&A transaction documents, including letters of intent, purchase agreements, and ancillary closing documentation A deep understanding of transaction structures, including stock purchases, asset purchases, mergers, acquihires, minority investments, and joint ventures Experience with both domestic and cross-border transactions Experience advising technology companies and startups on the unique legal issues they present Preferred qualifications At least 5-8 years of M&A legal experience at a nationally recognized law firm and/or in-house at a high-growth technology company Experience with public company securities law compliance and SEC reporting Experience with equity compensation matters in the deal context Experience with AI, machine learning, or other emerging technology companies Experience building M&A playbooks, templates, or processes on a lean team Exceptional analytical, drafting, negotiation, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex legal issues into clear, practical advice Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple transactions and priorities simultaneously An independent self-starter who can drive projects forward with minimal supervision, and collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders at all levels Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect all staff to be able to work from our San Francisco, New York, or Seattle office at least 3 days a week, though we encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $265,000 — $335,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Staff Software Engineer, Compute Platform (Routing)
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Staff Software Engineer on the Compute Platform team within the Platform Product Group, you'll own the routing layer that connects every service at Coinbase to its customers. items.title: Applied AI Architect, Perplexity Computer
items.description: Perplexity is seeking an Applied AI Architect to help our customers turn Perplexity Computer into working solutions that drive measurable impact. This role is ideal for technical, consultative professionals who have led complex software implementations and can move comfortably between customer discovery, solution design, hands-on delivery, and executive communication. About the role Perplexity Computer is a new class of AI system that navigates tools, interacts with applications, and completes multi-step workflows end to end. Our customers are using Computer to transform work that traditional software has not been able to address. Applied AI Architects work directly with customers across presales, onboarding, adoption, and strategic engagements. You will uncover the real business problem, determine what Computer can credibly support, design and configure the workflow, and lead the engagement to a clear outcome. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role at the intersection of solutions architecture, technical consulting, and program delivery. You will work closely with Sales and Customer Success while serving as a quality filter for requests that require Product or Engineering. What you'll do - Lead technical discovery. Work with customer business leaders, technical teams, account executives, and customer success managers to understand the users, current workflow, desired outcome, constraints, and decision-makers. - Design credible solutions. Map how people, data, tools, approvals, permissions, and decisions interact, then determine how Computer can support the workflow. - Support complex opportunities. Partner with account executives on technical deal strategy, demos, proofs of value, architecture and security coordination, and engagement scoping. - Drive value-backed consumption. Identify high-value, repeatable workflows; define the expected business outcomes and usage patterns; and partner with Sales and Customer Success to move customers from technical validation to sustained production use and expansion. - Build hands-on. Configure, prototype, test, and iterate on Computer skills and workflows, including connectors, permissions, and adjacent tooling. - Accelerate onboarding and adoption. Provide second-level technical consultation to customer success managers and deliver bounded technical work when customer needs exceed standard Customer Success coverage. - Run strategic engagements. Establish scope, customer commitments, milestones, success criteria, working cadence, and exit criteria, then lead the work through closure. - Improve technical escalation. Validate product and engineering needs and produce decision-ready requests with clear evidence, constraints, impact, and acceptance criteria. - Turn every engagement into leverage. Convert repeated customer needs into reusable workflows, implementation patterns, demos, guidance, and product feedback. What we're looking for The strongest Applied AI Architects combine technical depth, consultative problem solving, and disciplined engagement delivery. You should be comfortable working hands-on with the product, advising customer executives, and managing the details required to deliver a successful outcome. Must-haves - 5+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as solutions architecture, senior sales engineering, AI implementation, forward deployed work, technical consulting, or technical program leadership. - Proven consultative discovery skills. You can turn an ambiguous request into a clear business problem, technical approach, and delivery plan. - Hands-on technical fluency. You are comfortable with APIs, integrations, authentication, identity, permissions, connectors, data flows, and technical troubleshooting. - Experience delivering complex implementations. You have managed scope, stakeholders, milestones, risk, expectations, and closure. - Strong solution judgment. You can distinguish education, configuration, implementation, support, product, and engineering problems and recommend the right path. - Commercial and consumption awareness. You can connect solution design and technical decisions to time to value, usage, credit consumption, customer economics, and expansion potential. - Executive-credible communication. You can explain technical trade-offs to senior decision-makers while working effectively with practitioners and engineers. - High agency in ambiguity. You can establish direction without waiting for perfect requirements, challenge weak assumptions, and make thoughtful decisions quickly. - AI-native working style. You use frontier models and AI tools regularly and have developed strong intuition for what current systems can and cannot do reliably. Nice-to-haves - Experience deploying agents or multi-step LLM workflows in complex enterprise environments. - Experience with Computer, MCP, enterprise identity, security, permissions, or workflow orchestration. - Experience in regulated or workflow-intensive industries such as legal, financial services, healthcare, or technology. - Prior forward deployed engineering, Applied AI, deployment strategist, solutions architecture, or technical consulting experience at an AI or enterprise software company. - A track record of turning customer implementations into reusable technical assets or product improvements.

items.title: Manager, Applied AI Engineering (Digital Natives)
items.location_text: San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, Mountain View
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Applied AI Engineering team partners closely with customers to help them turn frontier AI capabilities into real products, workflows, and business impact. We act as trusted technical partners across strategy, solution design, architecture, implementation, evaluation, and adoption, working alongside customers to build and scale effective AI applications with OpenAI’s technologies. The Digital Natives segment serves technology and software companies that are building AI into the core of their products and businesses. These customers are often highly technical, move quickly, and are among the earliest adopters of OpenAI’s newest capabilities. Our Applied AI Engineers work directly with their engineering, product, and technical leadership teams to identify high-impact opportunities, solve complex technical challenges, and bring ambitious AI applications into production. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a Manager, Applied AI Engineering (Digital Natives) to lead the team responsible for the technical success of our most strategic technology and software customers in the Americas. In this role, you will lead a team of Applied AI Engineers who work hands-on with customers to design, build, evaluate, and scale AI applications. You will help determine where deep technical partnership can unlock the greatest customer and business impact, while developing repeatable approaches that allow the team to support a broad and fast-moving customer segment. As a manager, you will set the strategy and operating model for the team, coach and develop engineers, and serve as a senior technical partner to customers and internal stakeholders. You will work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Research to connect what we learn from customers with OpenAI’s product direction and help customers take advantage of our newest capabilities. Success in this role will be measured by meaningful production applications, sustained adoption and usage, strong customer outcomes, and technical patterns and insights that can be applied across the broader Digital Natives segment. This role is open in our San Francisco office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL - Own the strategy and operating model for the Digital Natives Applied AI Engineering team, ensuring alignment with OpenAI’s objectives and the evolving needs of technology and software customers. - Lead, hire, mentor, and develop a team of high-performing Applied AI Engineers responsible for delivering meaningful technical and customer outcomes. - Guide the team in working hands-on with customers to identify high-impact use cases, design and build AI applications, solve technical challenges, and scale successful solutions into production. - Partner closely with Sales to prioritize technical engagement across strategic customers and identify where Applied AI Engineering can unlock adoption, usage, and long-term customer growth. - Serve as a senior technical partner and escalation point for priority customers, building trusted relationships with engineering leaders, CTOs, and other executive stakeholders. - Represent the technical voice of Digital Native customers by synthesizing insights around model performance, developer experience, product gaps, emerging use cases, and technical blockers for Product, Engineering, and Research. - Translate recurring customer needs and successful implementations into repeatable technical patterns, reference architectures, playbooks, tooling, and best practices that allow the team to scale its impact. - Coach Applied AI Engineers on technical quality, customer judgment, prioritization, executive communication, and cross-functional partnership. - Help customers understand and apply OpenAI’s newest capabilities, identifying opportunities to build differentiated products and experiences with frontier models. - Champion the safe, reliable, and effective application of OpenAI’s technology across the Digital Natives ecosystem. YOU’LL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU - Have 8+ years of experience in deeply technical, customer-facing roles such as applied engineering, solutions architecture, deployment engineering, technical consulting, or similar roles. - Have 2+ years of experience leading technical teams, with a demonstrated ability to hire, develop, mentor, and manage high-performing engineers. - Have experience building or deploying generative AI, machine learning, developer platforms, or cloud-based software solutions in production environments. - Bring strong technical depth across APIs, AI/ML systems, application architecture, cloud infrastructure, and modern developer workflows. - Have hands-on software engineering experience and fluency with programming languages such as Python or JavaScript. - Are comfortable working directly with highly technical engineering and product teams as well as CTOs and other executive stakeholders. - Can translate ambiguous customer and business problems into clear technical approaches and guide teams from exploration through implementation and production. - Demonstrate strong judgment about when to invest deeply in an individual customer challenge versus when to develop a repeatable solution for the broader segment. - Are an effective communicator who can translate complex technical and business topics across audiences and coach others to do the same. - Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and are energized by working with customers at the forefront of AI adoption. - Demonstrate strong ownership, humility, curiosity, and a commitment to helping both customers and teammates succeed. - Are personally committed to fostering the safe and beneficial development of AI. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. items.title: Talent Acquisition, GTM - North America
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The Role As a member of the US Talent Acquisition team focused on Sales and Go-To-Market hiring, you will be instrumental in building and scaling Mistral's US-based revenue-generating teams from the ground up. Joining early means you'll help shape both our GTM recruitment strategy and operations, partnering closely with GTM leadership across Sales, Pre-Sales/Solutions, Partnerships, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations. Your work will directly influence our commercial success by ensuring we find and engage exceptional operators who will drive Mistral's growth in the US market. In this role, you'll also foster a strong candidate experience and help establish GTM recruiting best practices as we expand across the US. What You Will Do GTM Stakeholder Partnership - Partner deeply with GTM leaders — from CRO and VP Sales to Pre-Sales and Customer Success leadership — to understand hiring needs, define role specs, and identify the right commercial talent. - Own full-cycle recruitment across all GTM functions: AEs (Enterprise, Mid-Market, SMB), SDRs, Solutions/Sales Engineers, Partner Managers, CS leaders, and RevOps - Advise hiring managers on market mapping, leveling, comp positioning, and competitive landscape for US GTM talent - Translate the nuances of each GTM role into compelling, accurate candidate outreach End-to-End GTM Recruitment - Own the full recruiting lifecycle from sourcing to close, operating with autonomy on complex, high-volume GTM roles. - Source passive and active candidates across US GTM talent pools, particularly in AI/ML, open-source software, and enterprise infrastructure markets - Conduct intake and calibration sessions with hiring managers to align on ideal candidate profiles and stage expectations - Drive efficient, high-conversion pipelines and close candidates in a fiercely competitive market for senior GTM talent Candidate Experience & Selling Mistral - Guide candidates through the hiring process with clear communication and a compelling narrative about Mistral's mission, culture, and trajectory. - Articulate Mistral's positioning in the AI landscape — frontier models, open-weight philosophy, and enterprise credibility — to differentiate us against better-known competitors - Provide candidates with real insight into our GTM motion, growth plans, and the specific impact of their role - Deliver a high-quality, respectful candidate experience at every stage, regardless of outcome Recruiting Operations & Data-Driven Improvement - Develop and refine GTM recruiting processes, tools, and documentation to improve outcomes and efficiency. - Use data to diagnose pipeline issues (e.g., drop-off at specific stages, time-to-fill by role) and propose targeted solutions - Build and maintain market maps, competitive intel, and talent pools for key US GTM segments - Standardize GTM interview rubrics, scorecards, and debrief practices across US GTM hiring teams Raising the Bar - Collaborate with GTM leadership and the broader Talent team to continuously elevate our hiring standards. - Contribute to defining and evolving our GTM talent acquisition strategy in the US as we scale from early commercial team to mature GTM org - Partner on employer-brand and outbound sourcing initiatives that position Mistral as a destination for top GTM talent What We're Looking For - 6+ years of recruiting experience, including 2+ years in a startup or high-growth B2B SaaS/infrastructure company, with a focus on Sales and GTM roles - Demonstrated ability to independently hire across the full GTM stack — from SDRs to senior AEs, Solutions Engineers, and GTM leadership - Deep network and sourcing expertise in US GTM talent markets, particularly in AI/ML, open-source, developer tools, or enterprise software - Track record of hiring in competitive, candidate-scarce markets where GTM candidates have multiple offers - Experience working across multiple US markets - Willingness to work on other roles as needs come up - Comfort navigating ambiguity and switching between strategic planning and hands-on execution - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence peers and senior GTM stakeholders without direct authority - Organized, detail-oriented, and able to juggle shifting priorities across a high-volume hiring slate - Professional experience with modern recruiting tools such as Ashby - Familiarity with the AI/ML landscape and the ability to credibly discuss frontier model capabilities with technical GTM candidates WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. items.title: Director of New Business
items.description: Grandstand is the intelligence layer powering informed decisions for consumers and partners across sports, gaming and entertainment, with a portfolio that includes Gambling.com, Casinos.com, OddsJam, RotoWire, Bookies.com and Spotlight.Vegas. The Director of New Business drives new commercial growth across the North America market. This is a hands-on sales role with a clear mandate: identify, win and close new commercial relationships across the region, and develop them into high-value partnerships. You will sell the full breadth of what Grandstand offers — not a single product — building your own pipeline, structuring deals that work for both sides, and turning first conversations into lasting senior partnerships. New Business and Market Growth Win new commercial business. Identify, pursue and close new commercial relationships applicable to all US P&Ls across the group. Build the pipeline that makes growth predictable rather than opportunistic. Sell the full Grandstand suite. Know the complete range of technology and inventory Grandstand has to offer — B2B affiliate partnerships, advertising inventory and premium placements, adtech integrations, fintech products, sports data services and our B2C consumer products — and take the right combination to each partner. Extend our reach through partners. Identify media owners, platforms and partners whose audiences can be monetized through Grandstand's operator relationships, technology and demand, and structure commercial models that work for both sides. Open new revenue lines. Identify adjacent categories, verticals and partner types the group is not yet monetizing, and make the commercial case for pursuing them. Build and run the pipeline. Maintain a qualified, forecastable pipeline with clear stages, conversion expectations and rigorous hygiene. New Business Strategy Shape the go-to-market. Map the operators, advertisers and partner types the region should be pursuing, prioritize targets by revenue potential and strategic fit, and build the outreach plan to convert them. Structure winning deals. Design affiliate and advertising deal structures for new partners within the region's pricing framework, and bring a clear commercial recommendation when a deal needs an exception. Deliver the number. Hit your new business target, keep a pipeline accurate enough for your VP to forecast from — coverage, conversion and timing — and flag risk to the number early. Connect new business to the sites. Align new partnerships to each site team's US revenue plan so wins land where they move the number most. Partnership Development Build and cultivate new relationships. Open doors with new operators and advertisers, cultivate those relationships from first contact, and develop them into high-revenue-generating senior partnerships. Own the early lifecycle. Ensure new partners are onboarded well, communicated with proactively and see value quickly — from signature through first renewal. Protect the economics. Monitor the performance of the deals you close, address underperformance early, and recommend where to invest, restructure or step back. Show up in the market. Represent Grandstand at industry events and conferences, and build the presence that keeps the pipeline warm. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Tech, Marketing and Content. Work with these teams to deliver the integrations, marketing materials and assets partners need, optimize campaign performance, and bring back the market feedback that shapes what they build next. Influence product and data. Feed operator and market intelligence into product and commercial planning so our offering stays ahead of where the market is going. Operate within the compliance framework. As part of a publicly listed company, ensure all commercial activity meets our legal, financial and regulatory obligations — contracts through legal review, deals within approval and financial reporting controls, and advertising, licensing and responsible-gambling standards met in every jurisdiction we operate in. What You Will Bring 5+ years of commercial experience in online gambling, sports betting, affiliate marketing or adjacent digital media. A demonstrable new business record. You have personally won and closed commercial deals, not only grown accounts you inherited. An established network of relationships across the North American iGaming and media industry, and the ability to activate it quickly. Fluency in affiliate commercial models (CPA, revenue share, hybrid, flat fee) and the confidence to negotiate them. The range to sell a multi-product suite — performance partnerships, media and advertising inventory, adtech, fintech and data — and package them into one commercial story. Strong commercial analytics: comfortable working in the numbers to diagnose performance and build a case. Professional presence — credible with operator stakeholders, internal teams and at industry events. Nice to Have Experience standing up commercial coverage in a newly regulated market. Exposure to B2B data, adtech or audience monetization products in addition to affiliate. How Success Is Measured New business won. Number and value of new operator and advertiser relationships closed in the region. [Target to confirm] Contribution to regional growth. Measurable increase in the group's North America revenue and margin across the portfolio. Partner development. Growth and retention within the partnerships you bring in. Pipeline health. Coverage, conversion rates and forecast accuracy. Perks & Benefits Competitive base salary and uncapped competitive commission structure on new sales generated Comprehensive private Healthcare Insurance Flexible work environment and home office available Home office allowance Gym & Leisure Allowance All the hardware and software you need to be successful Regular company events and social outings, activities, Spot Awards and a Monthly Social Club Access to courses for Personal and Career Development Company Paid Volunteer Day Base Salary: $150,000–$175,000 USD

items.title: Deployment Strategist - DHS/DOJ
items.description: Scale is building AI for the world’s most important decisions. From the front lines of homeland security to the core of global enterprise, we provide the data engine and agentic infrastructure that powers the next generation of American and allied interests. As a Deployment Strategist supporting DHS and DOJ, you will be responsible for bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI research and mission-critical production. You will lead the charge in deploying Agentic AI, autonomous reasoning systems, into the heart of homeland security and law enforcement workflows, ensuring that some of the nation’s most consequential decisions are supported by the world’s best technology. Deployment Strategist (DHS/DOJ) We are looking for a powerhouse executive account leader who understands that winning at DHS and DOJ isn’t about a successful 6-month pilot; it’s about becoming an enduring, funded capability inside a component’s operational baseline. You will focus on landing and transitioning high-stakes prototypes into full-scale enterprise deployments, navigating the complexities of the Valley of Death by securing executive sponsorship and programmed funding. Responsibilities: This is an individual contributor role with heavy leadership expectations. You are the "CEO of the Account," responsible for the following: Full-Spectrum Capture & Quota Ownership: Carry and exceed a multi-million dollar annual revenue quota. You are responsible for the entire lifecycle: from identifying the top of funnel opportunity and shaping requirements to the final contract award and revenue recognition. Tactical Execution: You don’t just delegate; you execute. You will personally draft high-impact white papers, lead the development of complex proposals, architect deal structures, and navigate the nuances of federal civilian contracting, including OTAs, GSA schedules, and component-specific IDIQ vehicles. Operational Transition: Once the deal is signed, your job isn’t over. You will continue to lead the account, ensuring that the delivery team (Engagement Managers, Technical PMs, Engineers, and Product) enables mission success. You are the primary point of contact for the customer, ensuring the pilot doesn’t just work, but scales. Renewal, Expansion, & Growth: Own the long-term account strategy. You are responsible for identifying the next use case, securing the follow-on funding, and driving the 10x growth that turns a single component deployment into a department-wide enterprise standard. Direct Agentic Solutioning: Work in the weeds with technical teams and end-users to co-design Agentic AI workflows. You must be able to translate a customer’s vision into a specific technical requirement that our engineers can build against. SI & Prime Orchestration: In partnership with Scale’s Partner Managers, you will actively manage and negotiate with Tier 1 Systems Integrators and federal primes to ensure Scale is the agentic AI engine of their larger programs. You will be the lead negotiator for sub-contracting and teaming agreements. Requirements: Experience: 10+ years of experience in complex enterprise IT sales or business development, specifically within DHS, DOJ, or the broader federal law enforcement and homeland security market. Proven Track Record: You have successfully closed and implemented multi-year deals exceeding $25M. You know how to get a line item in the budget. Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of DHS and DOJ modernization priorities, specifically in AI/ML, computer vision, biometrics, screening and vetting, investigative analytics, or case management. The Valley of Death Navigator: You have a demonstrated ability to transition technology from "cool demo" to "deployed capability" within a major component program office. Strategic Network: Existing high-level relationships across DHS and DOJ components (CBP, ICE, USCIS, TSA, CISA, FBI, DEA, ATF, USMS) and their CIO and enterprise IT organizations, as well as a Rolodex of contacts at the major federal integrators. Clearance: Active Secret clearance is strongly preferred; TS/SCI and existing component suitability are a plus. Education: BS/BA required; technical degree or MBA preferred. Geography: Based in the National Capital Region, with the ability to work out of Scale’s D.C. office 2-3 days a week. Travel: Ability to travel 20-30% of the time. Who you are: Mission-Driven: You believe that whoever wins in AI wins the next century, and you want that to be the United States and its allies. Relentless: You thrive in the long-game of defense procurement. You aren't discouraged by bureaucracy; you see it as a puzzle to be solved. Adaptive: You can operate in the high-velocity environment of a Series E startup while maintaining the polish required for the Pentagon. The Closer-Operator: You have the executive presence to brief a PEO. Radically Accountable: You don't wait for a marketing lead or a BD specialist to hand you a deal. You build your own funnel, navigate the "No's," and find the creative path to "Yes." Technically Credible: You aren't a software engineer, but you can explain the difference between RAG and Agentic reasoning to a skeptical technical evaluator.
